prefixes.bounded_context: conversation messages, normalized conversation state, realtime delivery, presence, routing, IM call signaling, IM notifications, IM automation, and IM stream frames
notes: Use im_ only for instant-messaging-owned tables.
Do not rename unrelated IAM, Drive, integration, ops, or platform tables to im_.
This registry governs the authoritative PostgreSQL contract; client-local stores own separate manifests and naming contracts.

non_im_prefix_policy.description: Tables outside the instant messaging bounded context keep their own business-domain prefix or existing approved legacy name. The im_ prefix is not a product-wide default.
